llm.clean_prompt:
Clean this text for text-to-speech narration. Return only the cleaned text, no commentary.

Rules:
- Remove URLs.
- Spell dates like 03/09/2026 as "the third of September, twenty twenty-six".
- Expand i.e. and e.i. to "in other words", and e.g. to "for example".
- Delete bibliography, references, works cited, and endnotes sections entirely.
- Simplify inline citations. Example: "Mark Fisher (2012). Terminator vs Avatar in #Accelerate: The Accelerationist Reader, Urbanomic, p. 342." becomes "Wrote Mark Fisher in twenty twelve".
- Improve phonetic readability otherwise.

Text:
{text}
